يضطرع (form VIII)
# يَضْطَرِعُ (yaḍṭariʕu) /jadˤ.tˤa.ri.ʕu/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِضْطَرَعَ (iḍṭaraʕa)
# يُضْطَرَعُ (yuḍṭaraʕu) /judˤ.tˤa.ra.ʕu/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِضْطَرَعَ (iḍṭaraʕa)
# يَضْطَرِعَ (yaḍṭariʕa) /jadˤ.tˤa.ri.ʕa/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِضْطَرَعَ (iḍṭaraʕa)
